prompt: Two seasons after Demar Derozan was traded to the San Antonio Spurs, who was the leading scorer for the fifth place team in the Western Conference?
answer: Two seasons after DeMar DeRozan was traded to the Spurs—during the 2019–20 season—the fifth-place Western Conference team was the Oklahoma City Thunder. Their leading scorer was **Shai Gilgeous-Alexander**, who averaged about **19.0 points per game**.
